```sql
SELECT
    AVG(CAST(t2.Consumption AS DOUBLE)) AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM
    sqlite_scan('db/customers.db', 'customers') AS t1
JOIN
    'csv/yearmonth.csv' AS t2
ON
    t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID
WHERE
    t1.Segment = 'SME' AND SUBSTRING(t2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
```
